title: 百吨火箭只送一吨上天？

segments.zh: 一百吨重的火箭，
segments.en: A one hundred ton rocket

segments.zh: 只把一吨多送上天？
segments.en: that lifts barely more than one ton to orbit?

segments.zh: 11 月 7 日，民营火箭谷神星二号，
segments.en: On November 7, the private rocket Ceres-2

segments.zh: 把 4 颗卫星送上了五百多公里的轨道。
segments.en: put four satellites into orbit over 500 km up.

segments.zh: 它今年一月首飞失利，
segments.en: Its first flight failed in January.

segments.zh: 这次复飞，成了。
segments.en: This time it worked.

segments.zh: 可公司自己公布的数字是：
segments.en: But the company's own numbers:

segments.zh: 起飞一百吨，送上天一点三吨。
segments.en: 100 tons at liftoff, 1.3 tons to orbit.

segments.zh: 一点三除以一百：
segments.en: 1.3 divided by 100:

segments.zh: 百分之一点三。
segments.en: just 1.3 percent.

segments.zh: 报道说，这个效率
segments.en: And reports say that efficiency

segments.zh: 在同类火箭里已经算领先。
segments.en: is world-class for its type.

segments.zh: 今天的烧脑问题：剩下那九十八吨多，
segments.en: Today's brain teaser: the other 98-plus tons,

segments.zh: 到底干嘛去了？
segments.en: where did they go?

segments.zh: 认识主角：小谷，
segments.en: Meet our hero, Gu:

segments.zh: 一百吨重，就为了扔一吨。
segments.en: a hundred tons, built to throw one.

segments.zh: 答案一：绝大部分是燃料，
segments.en: Answer one: most of it is fuel,

segments.zh: 几分钟就烧光了。
segments.en: burned in a few minutes.

segments.zh: 为啥要烧这么多？
segments.en: Why so much?

segments.zh: 因为它得跑得飞快。
segments.en: Because it has to go incredibly fast.

segments.zh: 在五百公里高绕地球转，
segments.en: To circle Earth 500 km up,

segments.zh: 速度大约每秒七点六公里。
segments.en: you need about 7.6 km per second.

segments.zh: 这是步枪子弹的七八倍，
segments.en: Seven or eight times a rifle bullet:

segments.zh: 北京到上海，两分多钟。
segments.en: Beijing to Shanghai in about two minutes.

segments.zh: 反转一：难的不是“上去”。
segments.en: Twist one: going up is not the hard part.

segments.zh: 五百公里，开车也就半天。
segments.en: 500 km is half a day's drive.

segments.zh: 真正难的是横着跑，
segments.en: The hard part is going sideways,

segments.zh: 快到一边往下掉，一边绕过地球。
segments.en: so fast that you fall around the Earth.

segments.zh: 就像扔球：扔得越快，落得越远，
segments.en: Like throwing a ball: faster means farther,

segments.zh: 快到地面弯下去的速度追上它，就再也落不了地。
segments.en: until the ground curves away as fast as it falls.

segments.zh: 这就是轨道：
segments.en: That is an orbit:

segments.zh: 一直在掉，永远掉不到。
segments.en: always falling, never landing.

segments.zh: 反转二：燃料越多，
segments.en: Twist two: more fuel

segments.zh: 要推的重量也越多。
segments.en: means more weight to push.

segments.zh: 火箭靠往后喷气往前跑，
segments.en: A rocket throws gas backward to go forward,

segments.zh: 就像在冰面上往后扔球，人就往前滑。
segments.en: like throwing balls behind you on ice.

segments.zh: 可燃料本身也有重量：
segments.en: But fuel has weight:

segments.zh: 多带的燃料，得先把自己推起来。
segments.en: extra fuel must first lift itself.

segments.zh: 这就是火箭方程：速度每多一截，
segments.en: That is the rocket equation: each step of speed

segments.zh: 燃料要成倍地往上翻。
segments.en: multiplies the fuel you need.

segments.zh: 我们按固体火箭粗算：
segments.en: Our rough estimate for a solid rocket:

segments.zh: 要跑出每秒九公里多，
segments.en: to reach over 9 km per second,

segments.zh: 起飞重量得是最后重量的三十倍左右，
segments.en: liftoff weight must be about 30 times the final weight.

segments.zh: 九成七都得是燃料。
segments.en: 97 percent fuel.

segments.zh: 可装燃料的壳子加发动机，
segments.en: But the tanks and engines alone

segments.zh: 就远不止那百分之三。
segments.en: weigh far more than 3 percent.

segments.zh: 反转三：所以火箭要边飞边扔。
segments.en: Twist three: so rockets drop pieces as they fly.

segments.zh: 小谷有四节：三级固体，加一级液体。
segments.en: Gu has four stages: three solid, one liquid.

segments.zh: 烧空一节，扔一节，
segments.en: Burn a stage, drop it,

segments.zh: 后面就不用背着空罐子跑。
segments.en: and stop hauling empty tanks.

segments.zh: 就像接力赛：跑累的下场，
segments.en: Like a relay race: the tired runner steps off,

segments.zh: 新的那棒接着冲。
segments.en: a fresh one sprints on.

segments.zh: 一棒接一棒，
segments.en: Leg after leg,

segments.zh: 最后把一点三吨推到每秒七点六公里。
segments.en: until 1.3 tons hits 7.6 km per second.

segments.zh: 友情提示：大火箭能做到百分之四左右，
segments.en: Fine print: big rockets reach around 4 percent;

segments.zh: 小火箭普遍更低。
segments.en: small ones usually less.

segments.zh: 液体燃料喷得更快，
segments.en: Liquid fuel shoots out faster,

segments.zh: 同样的燃料能多跑一截。
segments.en: so the same fuel goes farther.

segments.zh: 固体火箭的好处是简单、准备快，
segments.en: Solid rockets are simple and quick to prepare,

segments.zh: 还能在海上发射。
segments.en: and can even launch from sea.

segments.zh: 所以那九十八吨去哪了？
segments.en: So where did the 98 tons go?

segments.zh: 大多烧成了气，空壳子掉了回来。
segments.en: Mostly burned to gas; the empty shells fell back.

segments.zh: 下次看到“一箭四星”，
segments.en: Next time you hear four satellites, one rocket,

segments.zh: 记得底下有一百吨在帮忙。
segments.en: remember the hundred tons underneath.

segments.zh: 小谷说：我一百吨，
segments.en: Gu says: I weigh a hundred tons

segments.zh: 就为了把这一吨扔得足够快。
segments.en: just to throw this one ton fast enough.
